title: Right-clicking search results doesn't do anything
line: Right-clicking a System Settings page in the Application Launcher's search results now opens a menu to add it to Favorites, the desktop or the Task Manager.
explanation: Kickoff only opens a context menu when a search result has a favorite id or reports an action list. RunnerMatchesModel gave both only to the services runner's results (applications: URLs); System Settings results from krunner_systemsettings carry a file: URL to the KCM's .desktop file, so they got neither, and the menu-building code also skipped them because it only accepted applications: URLs. The change adds one helper that finds the KService for both runners and uses it for HasActionListRole, the favorite id, the action list and trigger(); Edit Application and the software-center entries stay limited to real applications.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: Give System Settings search results a context menu

Only the services runner's results were turned into a service, so KCM
results had no menu or favorite id. Look the service up for both runners
and use it for the menu, the favorite id and the triggered actions.

BUG: 519038

media.caption: Master: Kickoff search 'display', right-clicking the System Settings result 'Display Configuration' only highlights it, no menu
With the fix: the same right-click opens Add to Favorites / Add to Desktop / Pin to Task Manager
'Add to Favorites' on the 'Locations' KCM result puts it in Kickoff's Favorites; clicking it opens the Locations page in System Settings
The same menu on another KCM result ('Locations', search 'dolphin')
